nar.text: Due to the enormous heat there was great concern among the various drivers whether their tires would last the whole race.

Taruffi's race came to a quick end when he arrived too fast in the right-hand turn at the downhill section leading into Capelle. The Alfa Romeo spun and the front crashed against a house, then the rear. The car could not continue, but the driver walked away.
